theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_rt_integrableOn_apply
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x)) μ) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => v x c) K μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
